integrity: The source half-edge formula is independently combined with Hadamard's determinant inequality, the arithmetic-geometric mean inequality, an elementary inductive constant-diagonal lemma, connectedness of the orthogonal parameter family, and the polar cross-polytope determinant formula. Finite numerical replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the centered ellipsoid pair in the higher-dimensional Fuss regime and the standard normalization with unit outer sphere. It does not treat nonconcentric ellipsoids, arbitrary cubical polytopes, or the source's simplex family, and it gives no quantitative stability estimate near the volume extrema.
title: Tight Fuss parallelotopes have an exact ellipsoid-controlled volume spectrum
